claims: Chance's second season premiered on October 11, 2017.
Chance is based on Kem Nunn's 2014 novel Chance.
Hugh Laurie stars as Dr. Eldon Chance in Chance.
Dr. Eldon Chance is a forensic neuropsychiatrist.
Dr. Eldon Chance lives in San Francisco.
Dr. Eldon Chance makes a decision involving a patient with multiple personality disorder.
Dr. Eldon Chance's patient has an abusive husband who is a police detective.
Dr. Eldon Chance deals with his own divorce.
Ethan Suplee stars as Darius "D" Cedars in Chance.
Stefania LaVie Owen stars as Nicole Chance in Chance.
Gretchen Mol stars as Jaclyn Blackstone in Chance.
Paul Adelstein stars as Raymond Blackstone in Chance.
